<Project>
  <PropertyGroup>
    <!-- Lets a PackageVersion below also fix the version of a package that arrives indirectly. -->
    <CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled>true</CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <!-- Exact versions, as resolved on 22 November 2026. Pin the Blazor AI components: a floating
       prerelease version picks the older 11.0.0-preview.7 build, which sorts above 0.1.0. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageVersion Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.AI" Version="0.1.0-preview.1.26466.103" />
    <!-- The Blazor AI preview asks for a release candidate of this package, which NuGet reports under
         advisory GHSA-m28h-pj36-4364 (NU1902). Pinning the released version clears it. -->
    <PackageVersion Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Validation" Version="11.0.0" />
    <PackageVersion Include="AGUI.Client" Version="1.0.1" />
    <PackageVersion Include="AGUI.Server" Version="1.0.1" />
